injuries.longComment: This is a new injury for Daniels, and the severity is unclear. In his most recent outing Sunday against the Bulls, Daniels had eight points (3-9 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 2-4 FT), nine rebounds, nine assists and two steals across 39 minutes. Nickeil Alexander-Walker and Vit Krejci could see increased minutes Tuesday with Daniels out.
injuries.shortComment: Daniels won't play Tuesday against the Bulls with right hip inflammation.

injuries.longComment: Dante made just four appearances at the NBA level in 2025-26, as he spent the bulk of his time with the College Park Skyhawks in the G League. In four appearances for the Skyhawks, Dante produced averages of 11.8 points, 5.8 rebounds and 2.2 assists.
injuries.shortComment: Dante will undergo season-ending surgery to repair a torn ACL in his right knee, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

injuries.longComment: Gueye is in danger of missing his first game of the season. His possible absence would free up some more playing time for Zaccharie Risacher and Asa Newell in the frontcourt, as Kristaps Porzingis (illness) remains on the shelf.
injuries.shortComment: Gueye is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Bulls with a sprained right shoulder.

injuries.longComment: The rookie big man is on a one-year, two-way contract, but he'll end the campaign having yet to make his NBA debut. Ndiaye averaged 8.1 points and 6.9 rebounds in 26.2 minutes spanning nine appearances with the Hawks' G League affiliate.
injuries.shortComment: Ndiaye has been diagnosed with a torn left labrum and will miss the remainder of the 2025-26 season, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.longComment: Porzingis has missed six of the past seven games for Atlanta due to a mysterious illness, so he'll take the next few weeks off to try and get to the bottom of exactly what he's been dealing with. Onyeka Okongwu should continue to start with Porzingis out, and Mouhamed Gueye will be more involved in the rotation. It sounds like the earliest Porzingis could be expected to return would be Dec. 29 versus the Thunder.
injuries.shortComment: Porzingis will miss at least the next two weeks of action as he undergoes further testing for the illness he's dealing with, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
